subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve every workspace `.env` key ending in `_ENDPOINT` as an untrusted endpoint-routing control?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically correct, but maintainers must explicitly accept the compatibility cost of extending the workspace dotenv trust boundary beyond named current consumers.

options.title: Accept suffix-wide boundary
options.body: Merge the documented generic `_ENDPOINT` block so current and future endpoint-routing variables fail closed in workspace dotenv.

options.title: Block named variables only
options.body: Limit the change to known endpoint consumers, preserving arbitrary workspace `_ENDPOINT` values but requiring ongoing denylist maintenance.

recommendation.title: Accept suffix-wide boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the documented generic `_ENDPOINT` block so current and future endpoint-routing variables fail closed in workspace dotenv.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the exact endpoint-redirection boundary and generic suffix strategy being extended.
